summary: Comprehensive UI testing of Resume Builder Premium Redesign completed. All 17 features tested successfully. 2-column desktop layout working with left column (Template picker + Tab navigation + Form editor) and sticky right column (Score panel V2 + Quick Fixes + Live Preview + Export). Score panel redesigned with 3 category groups (ATS Readiness, Recruiter Readability, Impact Strength). CareerToolDetail wrapper cleaned up with breadcrumb, Free badge, and Cloud Sync indicator. Below-the-fold content (How It Works, FAQs, Related Tools) renders correctly.
